mission: Collector re-release of #302 (Playwright 1.65.2, owner t537, 2026-11-19 20:42 MYT, content-pipeline ops/decisions.md L568) plus the fleet record of migration 7d2f9b4e1a63 (#303 P5). #302's own delivery (CI run 44685688317) rolled every collector back at 2026-11-20 07:03Z because #303 was merged by hand at 07:01Z during the rollout, so the staging head no longer equalled #302's merge commit ('Obsolete collector delivery; no upload allowed'). This PR changes no code: it carries the same collector_services request so staging-automerge releases the ten collectors one at a time on its merge commit (which contains #302 and #303), each restored to its previous deployment on failure, then verifies staging. It also moves docs/agent/STAGING_FLEET.json revision from cb7419af37e9 to 7d2f9b4e1a63, which delivery verify requires once the owner has applied that migration with apply-migration (dry run then apply). Draft: the owner marks it ready only after the migration apply receipt shows alembic_version_after 7d2f9b4e1a63, inside 14:00 to 03:00 MYT, and does not hand-merge anything into staging while its delivery runs.

impacts.reason: Records why the 20 Nov #302 delivery became obsolete (hand merge of #303 during the rollout) and the check to make before any hand merge. The infrastructure effect is this PR's purpose: the mission-scoped sequential release of all ten staging collectors on the merge commit, which carries #302's Playwright 1.65.2 images.

revision cb7419af37e9 -> 7d2f9b4e1a63 (#303 migration, after the owner's apply-migration run); nothing else changes. Collector component pins stay 2f6b0c4d until the pin follow-up after this delivery verifies.

resources: Verify staging merge expectations for the collector fleet
routes: No new route. No extra source request from this change.
dependencies: apply-migration 7d2f9b4e1a63 on parent cb7419af37e9 applied by the owner before Ready for review (until then delivery verify fails on the revision by design, OPS_RUNBOOKS.md apply-migration step 5)
then a fleet-pin PR (yuyu_reader_component and snkr_component to this merge SHA)
impact.deployment_impact: Collector release of #302's code: each collector re-uploaded on the merge commit in its own slot with automatic rollback to the deployment captured before upload. Must start 06:00-22:59 UTC; team rule: collector deliveries only 14:00 to 03:00 MYT. services/api is not changed, so the API does not rebuild. No schema change in this PR.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures each collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id rows are reference only, carried from grok-playwright-1-65-2). Do not re-run a failed delivery job; recover with another follow-up PR carrying the same request. Fleet record: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: A collector failing to launch the browser after release, a rise in browser launch or page timeouts in collector logs, a change in capture results on the post-release due runs, or delivery verify reporting a migration revision mismatch.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change in this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify (migration revision 7d2f9b4e1a63, natural collector receipts on the merge commit). Then one SNKRDUNK and one Yuyu-Tei due run on staging read back from the run log, then the version-record follow-up (docs/agent/STAGING_FLEET.json component pins) merges before anything else is armed.
